acceptance_criteria: The close button and the line naming the board the child will see are visible without scrolling at 360x640 while the area is scrolled to any position
Adding, removing or moving a concept changes the position of no other editable row in its list, and a removed concept can be put back at its former position with one action
A profile can be renamed and deleted; deleting asks again, says what is lost, and deleting the active profile leaves the child with the examples and says so
Ids this version cannot edit keep their exact place through every action, including undo
User-facing text is German and no profile name appears outside the caregiver region
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: A caregiver sets up and maintains a child's board quickly and without surprises: a header that stays with a close button and the board the child will see, profile cards with rename and delete, a board editor of two lists in which only the acted-on row moves and the last removal can be undone, and a short notice with the details one tap away.
non_goals: No rewording of concepts, no custom concepts, no export or import
No change to src/profiles/, src/board-data.ts, src/app.ts, src/startup.ts, src/board.ts or src/speech.ts
No new runtime dependency and no password
